decision: Is there enough pipeline to hit the target, and should we build pipeline, advance deals or improve conversion?
limitations: The forecast is only as good as the probabilities. Optimistic ones give a wish, not a forecast; take them from real conversion history and mark them as assumed if not.
Required coverage is 1 divided by your win rate, and commit is deals at 75% or more. A wrong win rate moves the coverage verdict and the new-pipeline figure together.
Close dates are read as written. A deal dated in the period counts in full even if it is slipping, and with no period end every open deal counts, so read the flagged deals before the totals.
The chance of reaching the target treats each deal as closing on its own. Deals that depend on the same budget or champion move together, so the real spread is wider.
review: The sales lead checks each deal's stage, the stage probabilities against historical conversion, and the win rate before the forecast goes to the board. Report commit and best case separately.
